sources.DFI: Data for India, 'Vehicle ownership in India' (HCES, MPCE quintiles), https://www.dataforindia.com/vehicle-ownership/
sources.EVR: EVreporter, 'Analysis of India's CY 2024 EV sales' (Vahan registrations), https://evreporter.com/analysis-of-indias-cy-2024-ev-sales/
sources.TATA: Tata Motors / TATA.ev statement reported in the press: 93 % of its EV owners charge privately (home / work) and use public chargers mainly for emergencies and long trips
sources.PAIGAM: PAIGAM, IFAT and University of Pennsylvania (2024), 'Prisoners on Wheels': survey of about 5,300 app-based cab drivers in 8 cities; 43 % report net monthly earnings below Rs 15,000
sources.CIS: Centre for Internet and Society, 'Platforming precarity: Mumbai': median monthly income of taxi workers, adjusted to a 48-hour week, Rs 14,846, https://cis-india.org/raw/mumbai-platforming-precarity
sources.CSTEP: CSTEP (2024), 'EV perceptions and usage patterns: lessons from four Indian cities' (878 personal and 855 commercial EV users); its per-segment charging figures could not be read (PDF link returned 404 on 22 Nov 2026), so they are not used

recommended.note: used in common/f4_params.json; pi_C rounded down from the central value, Beta parameters rounded to half units
